name: Uniform polygon second area moments
definition: For CCW simple polygon vertices (x_i,y_i) with cyclic indices, let c_i=x_i y_(i+1)−x_(i+1)y_i. Then M20=Σ_i c_i(x_i²+x_i x_(i+1)+x_(i+1)²)/12, M02=Σ_i c_i(y_i²+y_i y_(i+1)+y_(i+1)²)/12 and M11=Σ_i c_i(2x_i y_i+x_i y_(i+1)+x_(i+1)y_i+2x_(i+1)y_(i+1))/24.
variables: c_i edge cross product; M20,M02,M11 raw area moments
assumptions: Simple CCW polygon of positive area, finite coordinates
limitations: Provisional raw moments about the coordinate origin; numerical stability, orientation and independent checks pending
failure_conditions: Invalid polygon or inconsistent vertex order.
computation: Sum signed edge terms; independent derivation and verification pending.

name: Affine lower envelope by monotone slope stack
definition: For lines f_i(x)=m_i x+b_i sorted by strictly decreasing slope after retaining the least intercept per slope, keep an envelope stack with increasing start breakpoints. For new line j and last line i, compute x_ij=(b_j−b_i)/(m_i−m_j); pop i if x_ij≤its start, and repeat; append j with its computed start or −∞ for the first line. Query the last start≤x to obtain min_i f_i(x).
variables: m_i slope; b_i intercept; x_ij crossing; x query
assumptions: Nonempty finite static line set with exact comparisons; minimum value only
limitations: Provisional envelope construction and query bounds pending review
failure_conditions: Inconsistent slope order, division by zero or incorrect breakpoint ordering.
computation: Sort, deduplicate slopes, maintain increasing breakpoints and binary-search query; admission testing pending.
